The XYZ file lists the centres of the gold nanoparticles in a model crystallite of a DNA-linked gold-nanoparticle superlattice (coordinates in nm; built from a published SAXS unit-cell size). Treat the particles as identical point scatterers on a perfect, infinite lattice with this geometry. At what q (in nm⁻¹, q = 4π sinθ/λ) does the second distinct Bragg reflection with nonzero intensity appear?

选项：
A. 0.0436 nm⁻¹
B. 0.1369 nm⁻¹
C. 0.2371 nm⁻¹
D. 0.2738 nm⁻¹
